chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Ṣafwān, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Ḥajjāj, who said:

I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who fondles his wife in the month of Ramadan until he ejaculates. He said: Upon him is an expiation like that which is upon one who has sexual intercourse.

key_terms.الْكَفَّارَةِ: the required expiation for violating the fast
key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramadan, the month of obligatory sawm (fasting)
key_terms.يَعْبَثُ: engages in intimate touching or playful contact

ai.seo_question: What is the kaffarah for a man who fondles his wife and ejaculates during the day in Ramadan?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who engages in intimate play with his wife during the day in the month of Ramadan until ejaculation occurs. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that the kaffarah upon him is the same as the kaffarah upon one who performs sexual intercourse, showing the gravity of invalidating the fast in this manner.
